title: Polished marble found at the crash site

tellings.quote: But in 1999, the Ramsies did actually find something. what looks like a little polished marble, totally out of place.

plain: In 1999, two searchers named Scott Ramsey and Suzanne Ramsey are said to have found what looked like a small polished marble, completely out of place, in Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico. According to UFO lore, a craft carrying alien bodies crashed there. Michels tells this himself in an episode about the site, presenting the marble as possible physical evidence that something came down there.
